top_signals.title: Treasury’s Tax Warning Leaves Key ETF Maneuvers Untouched
top_signals.summary: Treasury’s ETF tax crackdown has left some popular strategies untouched.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: US Suspends Visa Program for Tech Firms Including Microsoft
top_signals.summary: The Trump administration said it would suspend an immigration program for multiple tech firms that allows foreign workers to obtain green cards, including Microsoft, alleging widespread abuse of a worker visa system. Ed Ludlow has more. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Turkey’s foreign minister says Ankara weighing Saudi defense support, rules out offensive role
top_signals.summary: Turkey, Pakistan and Saudi Arabia signed the Mecca Joint Defence Agreement, under which an armed attack on one member is considered an attack on all.
